correction.objective: For D informative donors, minimize D^-1 sum_d {ell_d(x_d^T beta + u_d) + eta u_d^2 / 2} + beta^T Lambda beta / 2.
correction.reason: The prior raw donor-sum implementation made the coefficient-ridge strength depend on whether a fit used seven leave-one-donor-out training donors or all eight source donors. Donor-mean normalization fixes the coefficient and donor-deviation penalties on a common per-donor scale.

mathematical_checks.strict_convexity: Positive coefficient and donor-deviation penalties give a unique finite penalized fit without a context-rank condition.

supersession: This artifact supersedes only the objective scaling and bound context-estimator hash in pre_access_implementation_clarification_v1.json. All other frozen protocol, schema, cross-validation availability, firewall, and terminality rules remain in force.
